title: Native SfM local BA subset and optional Schur-cache comparisons

preprocessing.undistorted: Same 640x480 dimensions and K; cv2.initUndistortRectifyMap + INTER_LINEAR remap, constant-black border. No resize or crop.

currentLocalSubsetComparison.scope: Current authored source and exact same harness, inputs, GPU adapter and limits; five full reconstruction snapshots per configuration. Only localBundleSubset differs. schurCache is false in both. No numerical-equivalence protocol is supplied or used.

modelNumericalComparison.scope: Entire reconstruction object, including every camera, pose, landmark, observation identity and pixel; no alignment or row matching applied

schurCacheComparison.scope: Same current authored source and harness, current/current execution; both enable localBundleSubset, only schurCache changes false to true. This is an execution-policy comparison, not a revision comparison.

sourceIdentification.method: Exact complete authored source and harness manifests recorded in raw reports; no final published commit or CI status is asserted by this benchmark record

strictTolerancePolicy.purpose: Floating-point comparison tolerance only; no model, observation, inlier, parallax or solver gate is relaxed

quality.coverageCaveat: Both variants register IDs2..11 only. Views0/1 remain disconnected; this is not12/12 connected reconstruction.

cacheCounterLimitations.scope: Actual reported kernel-group calls. Counts include cache construction and original-operator certificate work in the measured wall interval.
cacheCounterLimitations.reason: Native mapper reports preserve kernel calls but do not expose explicit cached-solve/certificate-failure/fallback state counters. Eight certificate dispatches do not by themselves prove eight successful certificates or zero fallbacks.

observedDefaultToBothComparison.scope: Direct observed means from the current-source local-off/cache-off report and current-source local-on/cache-on report on the same native scene, authored source, harness, inputs, adapter and limits. This is not a new two-flag preregistered comparison and does not multiply historical ratios.
observedDefaultToBothComparison.qualityEvidence: Composition of exact entire-model equality across all five local-off versus local-on/cache-off trials and the separately predeclared, all-five-trial cache-off versus cache-on numerical-equivalence checks. The cache model has explicitly nonzero raw differences; no new combined strict-equality or combined preregistration claim is made.
observedDefaultToBothComparison.interpretation: Four warm wall samples per configuration on one 12-frame 640x480 scene; no general speedup or full-video throughput claim.

priorLocalSubsetComparison.scope: Earlier frozen baseline/current comparison, three full snapshots and two warm wall samples per variant. Different source/harness context from the later same-source cache experiment; ratios must not be multiplied into a controlled combined claim.
priorLocalSubsetComparison.status: Historical evidence only; superseded for current acceptance by currentLocalSubsetComparison.
priorLocalSubsetComparison.reproducibilityGap: All 52 authored runtime source files match the archived proposed-v1-src tree, but the exact historical native-scene-runner.ts and native-scene-test.mjs bytes are unavailable. Current harness files must not be described as the historical drivers. Historical results are preserved without a complete harness reproducibility claim.

rejectedProposalStrategy.status: Rejected and excluded from accepted production route
rejectedProposalStrategy.reason: Faster proposal-based tracks worsened common-observation reprojection and GT rotation; local-only and cache comparisons do not make that strategy accepted.

limitations: One native640x480 12-frame excerpt; source RGB frames are analyzed at their original dimensions after explicit same-size RGB undistortion.
Raw cold label means first measured browser-session trial, not OS/driver-cold execution.
Measured wall excludes model/input loading, hashes, RGB conversion, oracle audits and compact-match export, as recorded by the harness.
Warm host stage times are measured durations, not GPU timestamps or occupancy. Timestamp queries are disabled in both wall variants.
Four warm samples in the cache comparison and two in the earlier local comparison are not a general workload benchmark.
No general COLMAP parity, whole-SfM100x, native4K/8K/18K or full-video-throughput claim.
Final regression and same-HEAD CI evidence is recorded separately in output deliverables after completion.
